bits.name: summonerSpell
bits.note: Set to put the wait on that slot of the unit's summoner spells; clear, on that slot of its own. A client fails where this is set for a unit with no summoner spells.

fields.name: timeLeft

fields.name: outOf
fields.note: The length the client shows that remainder against, in seconds: 20 left out of 40 shows the wait half run.
